name: 36 Stratagems · Classical
description: 36 Stratagems classical deck: 36 stratagem cards + 6 overview cards with source, meaning, story and reflection. Flip, read, mark, favorite.

sampleData.name: Cross the Sea Under Camouflage
sampleData.source: When precautions are complete, vigilance slackens; the familiar is trusted. The hidden lies within the obvious, not apart from it.
sampleData.explanation: Show the ordinary to hide the extraordinary, so the enemy drops its guard through sheer familiarity.
sampleData.story: Xue Rengui built a "mansion" for the sea-fearing Emperor Taizong and feasted him while a great ship carried them across — a surprise landing hidden in plain sight.
sampleData.reflection: The enduring truth: what is shown openly is rarely questioned. Mastery is making the decisive move look like routine.

sampleData.name: Besiege Wei to Rescue Zhao
sampleData.source: To attack a massed enemy, divide it; strike where it is weak rather than meet its strength head-on.
sampleData.explanation: Instead of relieving Zhao directly, strike Wei’s capital so the enemy must turn back — then ambush it worn and divided.
sampleData.story: At Guiling, Sun Bin besieged Wei’s capital, broke the siege of Zhao, and captured Pang Juan on the march.
sampleData.reflection: Pressure the point your opponent cannot abandon; they will retreat from where you are weak to defend where they are weak.

sampleData.title: Winning Stratagems
sampleData.theme: The Art of Offense from Strength
sampleData.body: These are used when you hold the initiative. The theme is turning strength into a decisive blow through disguise and timing, not brute force.
